name: pc-tidy
description: List what has gone unused on your Mac and delete only the items you pick to free up disk space

interface.shortDescription: Free up space on your Mac
interface.longDescription: Scans your home folder for work folders, local repositories, apps, leftovers of removed apps, old tool versions, AI models, Docker images, and growing logs that have gone unused for 30 days. It opens a page that says what each item is and whether it is safe to delete. It deletes only the items you pick, re-checking each one for uncommitted changes and running processes right before deleting it, and reports how much space came back. It never deletes rebuildable caches, photos, keys, or iCloud Drive. macOS only.
defaultPrompt: List what has gone unused on this Mac and free up disk space
